assertions.name: V_222_leading_order_is_eps6
assertions.source: PR #664 claims V_(2,2,2) is the order-h^6 channel for F_3. Finite-difference extraction of the leading non-constant Taylor order of y_(2,2,2)(q)·χ^(2,2,2)(σ_1²) at q=1+ε tests this directly.

assertions.name: V_222_eps6_coefficient_matches_framework_ansatz
assertions.source: If k=6 and coefficient = -2·b³(q=1) = -3√3/4 ≈ -1.299, PR #664's V_(2,2,2) → F_3 chain is confirmed.

description: V_(2,2,2) per-block contribution to tr_M(σ_1² in H_6) leading Taylor order at q=1+ε, extracted via finite-difference / log10-ratio dominance at 100-dps precision. Tests PR #664's claim that V_(2,2,2) contributes at order ε^6 matching the framework F_3 = -2·b³·ℏ_q^6 ansatz.
caveats: Finite-difference extraction at 100-dps precision rather than exact symbolic series (sympy Wenzl y_(2,2,2) at order ε^8 is intractable: hundreds of half-integer-power terms). The dominance method is robust for extracting the leading Taylor order but loses sub-leading precision.
